name: call_routine_three_times
description: Calls one unnamed routine three times in succession and then returns, with no other work in its body.

name: start_blitter_d0_wait
description: Writes the value from the first data register into the blitter size register, then spins until the blitter busy bit clears.

name: start_blitter_d1_wait
description: Writes the value from the second data register into the blitter size register and waits for the blitter busy bit to clear.

name: start_blitter_d7_wait
description: Writes the value from data register seven into the blitter size register and waits for the blitter busy bit to clear.

name: start_blitter_fixed_wait

name: call_indirect_slot_return_d1

name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: Calls one unnamed routine and then ORs a constant into a word field, but decoding then runs into invalid bytes, so the body is only a stub and nothing further can be recovered.

name: scan_table_then_copy_words
description: Scans a byte table for any value above 110. If none is found it copies the table into RAM as words and copies eight longwords into fixed fields of a base-relative block; either way it clears two words at the end.

name: invoke_slot_then_conditional_follow
description: Calls a handler through a slot in an A2-relative table; if that handler returns nonzero it calls an unnamed routine and then a second slot of the same table, and returns the data register pair.

name: call_table_slot_after_setup
description: Makes one unnamed call, then invokes the handler stored in a fixed slot of an A2-relative table and returns the data register pair unchanged.

name: stub_empty_return
description: Contains only a return and does no work. The referenced text label for a high score is not used by the body.

name: patch_matching_call_sites
description: Walks a large memory block one word at a time and, where a word matches the data register and the following long points at the global cell, rewrites that word as a jump opcode and stores the address from the A4 register in the long.

name: return_concatenated_registers
description: Calls one unnamed routine and then returns a 64-bit value formed by joining two data registers.

name: return_concatenated_registers
description: Calls one unnamed routine and then returns a 64-bit value formed by joining two data registers.

name: call_once_and_return
description: Calls one unnamed routine and returns, with no further work.

name: init_input_entry_table
description: Derives an index from a value returned by an unnamed input-reading routine, then fills four 48-byte entries with default values and handler addresses taken from a table, and finally writes control values.

name: reset_audio_channel_registers
description: Zeroes a group of memory cells and writes zero and full-byte values to the shared hardware cell that covers the audio volume and DMA control registers, leaving the channels silent.

name: enable_channel_dma_if_flagged
description: When a flag cell is nonzero, builds a DMA control word with the enable bit set plus one bit for each of four channels, writes it to the DMA control register, and then clears the shared cell.

name: dispatch_four_nonzero_flags
description: Checks four flag bytes in turn and calls an unnamed routine for each one that is nonzero.

name: tick_audio_channels_with_stop
description: Advances a per-frame update for four audio channels: it steps each channel's command stream, writes period and volume values to the audio registers, and when the sequence ends it clears channel state and writes control values to the DMA register.

name: advance_channel_command_step
description: Runs one pass of a channel's command stream for the sound update, applying the note, period and volume results, and returns the last computed value; it clears the channel state when the stream finishes.

name: update_channel_vibrato_and_pitch
description: Steps each of four channels, applying a pitch or vibrato offset taken from the command data, updates the period and volume words, and sets a channel's DMA enable bit when a new note starts.

name: start_channel_note_and_dma
description: Loops over the audio channels, writing initial period and pointer values to the audio registers, then processes command bytes from each channel stream and sets the channel's DMA enable bit when a note starts.

name: tick_four_channels_then_dispatch
description: Runs the four-channel note update loop, applying each channel's period and volume, and at the end calls an unnamed handler for every channel whose flag cell is nonzero.

name: update_channel_effects_loop
description: Applies volume slides and effect offsets to each of four channels, writes the results to the audio registers, and dispatches unnamed handlers for channels whose flags are set.

name: apply_slide_offset_to_channels
description: Adds a slide value to each channel's pitch, applies a periodic modulation step where the modulation flag is set, updates the audio registers, and dispatches channel handlers at the end.

name: toggle_sign_modulated_period
description: Alternates the direction of a modulation step for each channel, adds or subtracts the step from the period value, writes it to the audio registers, and dispatches channel handlers at the end.

name: step_period_by_delta
description: Subtracts a fixed delta from the running pitch value of each channel, writes the result and the volume to the audio registers, and after four channels dispatches the channel handlers.

name: decode_channel_command_stream
description: Reads command bytes from a channel's data stream: values with the top bit clear select a note and set its length and pointer, while other values set jump, envelope or effect parameters, then the channel's DMA bit is written.

name: decode_commands_full_range
description: Reads command bytes from a channel stream and dispatches the full set of command ranges, including note, jump and effect parameter commands, updating the channel's pointer fields for each one.

name: decode_commands_upper_range
description: Reads command bytes from a channel stream and handles the upper command ranges only, setting the note, jump and envelope fields and starting the next note.

name: decode_commands_minimal_range
description: Reads command bytes from a channel stream and handles only the highest command range, with note and jump setup, and then writes the channel's note start values.

name: dispatch_command_table_entry
description: Loads a handler offset from a word table indexed by the low byte of the data register and calls the handler at that offset from the base register.

name: reset_channel_state_cells
description: Clears ten channel state cells in the player block, then writes control values of fifteen and two hundred fifty-five to the shared hardware cell that covers the audio and DMA control registers.

name: build_sample_table_from_headers
description: Builds a table of six sample entries from a packed header list: each entry gets a data pointer, a half-length value and a period found by dividing a fixed constant by the stored rate, then a buffer is filled with a fixed pattern word and an initialised flag is set.

name: dispatch_four_nonzero_flags
description: Checks four flag bytes in turn and calls an unnamed routine for each one that is nonzero.

name: step_channel_envelope_and_slope
description: Advances one channel's envelope counter and, when it expires, writes a stored value to the DMA control cell and clears a flag; otherwise it applies a pitch slope and a vibrato step to the channel period.

name: step_channel_pitch_slide
description: Applies a pitch slide to one channel: it counts down a slide timer, adds the slide amount to the period, and resets the period from a second counter when it expires, also writing the channel's DMA bit.

name: stub_return_saved_value
description: Calls one unnamed routine and returns the eight-byte value passed on the stack unchanged; it is a wrapper that does no hardware or data work.

name: return_concatenated_registers
description: Calls one unnamed routine and then returns a 64-bit value formed by joining two data registers.

name: call_when_flag_clear
description: Tests a global flag byte and calls an unnamed routine only when the flag is zero, then returns.

name: return_concatenated_registers
description: Calls one unnamed routine and then returns a 64-bit value formed by joining two data registers.

name: zero_fill_memory_range
description: Writes zero longwords from a start pointer up to an end pointer, clearing the whole memory range between them.

name: clear_flag_wait_for_set
description: Clears a word flag in the base-relative block and busy-waits until another routine sets that flag to a nonzero value.

name: delay_loop_counted_down
description: Spins a counter in the seventh data register down to zero as a plain delay loop with no other work.

name: call_routine_count_times
description: Calls one unnamed routine once per count held in the seventh data register, counting down to zero.

name: poll_flags_with_countdown
description: Counts down a value in the seventh data register while checking two base-relative flag bytes, returning early as soon as either is nonzero; a third comparison of a cell with itself never triggers.

name: copy_block_to_fixed_address
description: Copies a block of memory from the global area to a fixed destination address, moving eight longwords per pass for a counted number of passes.

name: expand_palette_bytes_to_colors
description: Converts eight source bytes into colour entries by doubling each byte and adding a fixed offset, storing each result as a longword in a RAM table for the colour registers.

name: copy_palette_block_to_ram
description: Copies a block of sixteen longwords from the source pointer into a RAM buffer, staging colour register values.

name: wait_for_sync_flag_sequence
description: When a base-relative flag byte holds the letter W, polls until it changes to X, returning early if either of two other flag bytes is set.

name: clear_paired_screen_blocks_full
description: Clears two screen-sized RAM blocks in step, writing zero longwords through both pointers for a fixed pass count, after recording a buffer pointer.

name: clear_paired_screen_blocks_part
description: Clears two screen RAM blocks in step over a shorter pass count, writing zero longwords through both pointers after recording a buffer pointer.

name: print_string_until_nul
description: Walks a zero-terminated text string and calls an unnamed character routine for each byte until it reaches the terminator.

name: process_text_control_codes
description: Interprets one text byte: codes with the high bit set reposition the write pointer by a column multiple, the carriage-return and shift-out codes move the line offset by fixed amounts, and printable characters are looked up in a glyph table relative to the space character.

name: run_frame_state_machine
description: Advances a frame counter and a timer, then checks a state byte against a few values, returning early for most of them and otherwise continuing to update the display buffer through unnamed routines.

name: call_four_routines_unrecovered
description: Calls four unnamed routines in sequence; the decompiler timed out, so only the call structure and entry facts are known and the body cannot be recovered further.

name: record_stack_low_mark
description: Compares the current stack position with a saved low-water mark and, if the stack has gone lower, replaces the mark with the saved register value.

name: match_byte_sequence_pointer
description: Compares the incoming byte with the next byte of a stored pattern and advances a match pointer on success; on mismatch it resets the pointer, and when the pattern ends it toggles a status word.

name: print_string_after_setup
description: Runs one setup call, then calls an unnamed routine for each byte of a zero-terminated string until the terminator.

name: format_decimal_digits
description: Converts a 32-bit number to a fixed-width decimal digit string by subtracting descending powers of ten and counting each digit into a buffer that starts as ASCII zeros.

name: blank_leading_zero_digits
description: Replaces leading zero characters in a digit string with spaces, stopping at the first nonzero digit or when the count runs out, and advances a column counter for each digit changed.

name: print_string_from_offset
description: Clears a base-relative counter, then calls an unnamed routine for each byte of a zero-terminated string until the terminator is found.

name: call_until_zero_byte
description: Calls an unnamed routine repeatedly while the byte at a pointer is nonzero, consuming the string one call at a time.

name: draw_glyph_into_bitplanes
description: Copies one character's pixel row into several bitplane buffers at a computed screen offset, writing the glyph byte to some planes and taking the others from the glyph table.

name: build_bit_combination_table
description: Fills a 256-entry table where each entry is a flag byte combining the bits of its index, with the high bit set when the index's top bit is set, giving a lookup table for bit tests.

name: init_state_and_build_colours
description: Clears four state words, makes three unnamed calls, then fills eight RAM entries from a pointer table, each one a table word doubled and offset by a fixed constant.

name: reset_state_and_build_colours
description: Clears four state words, makes three unnamed calls, then fills eight entries with table words doubled and offset by a fixed constant, without the leading byte store of its neighbour.

name: swap_display_buffer_pointers
description: Compares the current display buffer pointer with the stored alternate, swaps them so the other buffer becomes active, and returns the previous pointer in the register pair.

name: install_interrupt_vectors_and_timers
description: Installs handler addresses into the first interrupt vector slots, loads an initial value into a CIA timer, and writes interrupt and DMA enable bits, calling thirteen unnamed routines during setup.

name: select_display_mode_two
description: Sets the mode value to two and copies about seventy words from the saved stack region into the display buffer, substituting a fill word past the limit, then writes several default state values.

name: select_display_mode_eleven

name: select_display_mode_current
description: Stores the current mode value, copies about seventy words from the saved stack region into the display buffer, runs a seven-pass loop, and sets the two colour registers.

name: rotate_nibbles_and_emit
description: Rotates a 32-bit value by four bits and passes it to an unnamed routine, seven times in a row, then advances a base-relative line offset by a fixed step.

name: handle_keyboard_serial_input
description: Reads the keyboard serial data state, converts the key code into a stored key value with a flag bit, and when the decoded code matches one fixed value it runs a sequence of setup calls.

name: acknowledge_keyboard_handshake

name: read_joystick_and_mouse_ports
description: Reads the two joystick and mouse port counters and the fire-button state, derives movement direction bits from the counter changes, stores them in input state cells, and calls two unnamed routines.

name: setup_display_registers_and_wait
description: Writes a block of display registers for bitplane control, display window, data fetch and modulo values plus a DMA control word, then waits for a status bit to set before returning.

name: set_copper_list_pointers
description: Writes an address from the A1 register into the first copper list pointer and the address of a fixed base cell into the second.

name: install_copper_list_pointers
description: Writes an address from the A1 register into the first copper list pointer and the address of a fixed base cell into the second, then returns.

name: wait_for_fire_button_cycle
description: Busy-waits until the fire-button state drops and then rises again, returning after one complete press and release.

name: build_packed_bit_tables
description: Fills two 256-entry tables: the first holds each index's bits packed into the high bits of a byte, the second holds the high nibble of that value, for use as lookup tables.

name: countdown_wait_sync_flag

name: erase_previous_character

name: append_character_to_text_line
description: Stores the input character at the current column of the text buffer, advances the column and holds it at twenty, then clears the pending input flag.

name: map_key_code_to_character
description: Masks the high bit from a key code and maps codes below seventy-one through a byte table to their characters, passing higher codes through unchanged.

name: step_three_phase_colour_stream
description: When a base-relative enable word is set, steps a three-phase counter, and on wrap reads the next code from a stream until it finds a nonnegative value, writes it to the background colour register and advances the stream pointer.

name: shift_bit_buffer_refill

name: init_form_state_fields

name: wait_for_raster_line

name: fill_row_offset_table
description: Writes five pairs of row address words into a table, each row address advanced by a fixed row stride from the previous one.

name: parse_colour_map_chunk
description: Scans a data block for the four-letter tag CMAP, then reads colour entries after it, converting each into a palette word and storing it for the colour registers.

name: copy_palette_words_to_buffer
description: Copies thirty-two words from the source pointer into a fixed buffer two words apart, staging a full colour palette.

name: copy_indexed_table_words
description: Copies twelve words from a table entry chosen by a state index into a fixed buffer, two words apart.

name: copy_indexed_table_quad
description: Copies four words from a table entry selected by a second state index into a fixed buffer, two words apart.

name: run_text_screen_loop
description: Runs a screen loop that clears state, makes many unnamed calls, and polls the fire button; the referenced text includes WELL DONE, HI SCORE TABLE and WILL.

name: set_flag_and_call
description: Sets a state field to one and then calls an unnamed routine.

name: call_once_and_return
description: Calls one unnamed routine and returns, with no further work.

name: call_once_and_return
description: Calls one unnamed routine and returns, with no further work.

name: call_once_and_return
description: Calls one unnamed routine and returns, with no further work.

name: call_once_and_return
description: Calls one unnamed routine and returns, with no further work.

name: init_score_table_defaults
description: Sets initial values for a score table: two words to all-ones, two words to twenty, a fixed limit word, then loops over five entries copying data pointers into the table.

name: wait_for_fire_or_timeout
description: Polls the fire-button state in nested counted loops and returns as soon as the button bit reads low, calling an unnamed routine between passes if the count runs out.

name: print_name_field
description: Walks a twenty-character field and calls an unnamed routine for each character that is not a space, leaving spaces alone.

name: wait_for_button_with_delay
description: Repeats an unnamed call and polls an input bit in nested counted loops, calling a routine between passes and using longer counted delays when the bit state changes.

name: cycle_four_frames_polling_input
description: Advances a four-step counter that wraps back to zero, calls two unnamed routines per step, then polls an input bit in nested counted loops before continuing.

name: format_score_digits_and_name
description: Converts a 16-bit score into six decimal digits by repeated division by ten, writes the digits into a text buffer, and references the name WILL.

name: run_name_entry_screen
description: Clears a twenty-character name buffer to spaces, then runs a loop of unnamed calls and input polling; the referenced texts include YOUR NAME and MOOG.

name: call_once_and_return
description: Calls one unnamed routine and returns, with no further work.

name: draw_score_table_rows
description: Makes seventeen unnamed calls to lay out the score table; the referenced text includes HI SCORE TABLE and a list of player names.

name: shift_table_entries_down
description: Shifts a table of words down by one position, moving each entry into the slot before it, to advance a rolling table.

name: handle_level_interrupt_request
description: Interrupt handler: when a request bit is set it clears the bit and calls unnamed routines, then saves a custom register snapshot, writes interrupt and DMA disable masks, and calls two routines.

name: scan_envelope_level_table
description: Scans a table of about 127 levels and selects the first entry above the current level, then applies the result to the envelope state and the audio volume registers.

name: advance_channel_step_counter
description: Advances a per-channel counter and, when it reaches the stored limit, resets it and clears a state word, makes four unnamed calls, then waits a fixed count before continuing.

name: start_audio_channel_pointers
description: Makes four unnamed calls, then while a channel flag is set clears it, advances a sample index with a seven-bit mask, and writes the channel pointer registers.

name: select_envelope_value_by_index
description: Chooses one of three values according to a counter taken modulo three, using a word or a nibble of a source byte, then scans a table of about thirty-six entries for the first one at or below it.

name: lookup_nearest_table_entry
description: Scans a table of about thirty-six words for the first entry not greater than a stored value, then writes the entry selected by a nibble of the source byte into a channel field.

name: copy_channel_word_field
description: Copies a word from the input record into a channel field.

name: lookup_table_entry_by_index
description: Scans a table of about thirty-six words for the first entry not greater than a stored value, then stores the entry selected by the index in the data register into a channel field.

name: store_channel_word_value
description: Stores the data register word into a channel field.

name: start_audio_dma_channels
description: Clears a channel field, makes four unnamed calls, waits through two fixed delay loops, sets the DMA enable bits, and writes the audio location registers from stored pointers.

name: decode_packed_note_record
description: Decodes a packed note record: combines a nibble from two bytes into an index, looks up a sample pointer and a period for that index in tables, and writes them into the channel fields.

name: apply_note_effect_fields
description: Stores the sample offset and volume in the channel record, then either calls an unnamed routine when the effect command equals a specific value or copies the period and effect fields into the channel.

name: copy_note_fields_to_channel
description: Copies a note's period, sample and effect fields into the channel record, masks the period to its low twelve bits, and writes the DMA control word for the channel.
